What We Do

Every trade, one point of contact.

From general repairs to full renovations, our multi-trade team handles the full scope of property maintenance — so you don't need to juggle contractors.

Roofing

Installations, repairs and inspections for pitched and flat roofs, keeping properties weathertight all year round.

Electrical Work

Certified electricians for rewiring, lighting, fault-finding and safety inspections across homes and businesses.

EICR (Electrical Safety Check) A full health check of your property's electrics. One of our qualified electricians tests the wiring, circuits and fixed appliances to make sure everything is safe, then provides you with a certificate for your records.

Plumbing

Leak detection, pipework, installations and general plumbing maintenance carried out to a reliable, lasting standard.

Carpentry

Custom joinery, structural framing and finish carpentry, built with precision for residential and commercial spaces.

Plastering

Smooth, durable plastering and rendering for walls and ceilings on new builds, renovations and repairs.

Painting & Decorating

Interior and exterior finishes applied with care, giving every property a clean, refreshed appearance.

Multi-Trade Maintenance & Repairs

General repairs and reactive maintenance covering the day-to-day upkeep of any residential or commercial property.

Waste Removal

Fast, responsible clearance of construction debris and unwanted materials, keeping sites clean and compliant.

Bricklaying

Garden walls through to full structural brickwork, built with attention to detail and long-term durability.

Air Conditioning

Supply, installation and servicing of split and multi-split air conditioning systems for homes and offices.

Kitchen & Bathroom

Full renovations and refits, from design through to installation, tailored to how the space will be used.

Solar Panel Installation

Professional solar installations that help homes and businesses reduce running costs and their carbon footprint.
